contact.full_name: MAYUR GUPTA Senior Associate — Financial Operations, Reconciliation & Change Management

data.summary:
Highly analytical Finance Professional with nearly 6 years (5.10 years) of total experience across the financial services domain, specialized in Trade Life Cycle processing, Trade Transaction Reporting Operations, end-to-end Reconciliation, and Change Management. Proven record in process automation, implementing robotics testing, and managing cross-regime regulatory compliance. Deployed business solutions using tools such as Jira, DTCC, Power BI, SQL, and Excel to establish robust structural controls, streamline systemic workflows, and mitigate functional risk.
CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
Core Domains: Trade Life Cycle Operations, Reconciliation Management, Change Management, Trade Transaction Reporting
Regulatory Regimes: EMIR, CFTC 1.0/2.0 Migration, SEC 1.0/2.0, Regulatory Reporting Standards • Financial Infrastructure: Equities, Corporate Actions, Money Markets, Derivatives, Open Trade Equity, Nostro & Depot Accounts
Technical Systems: Jira, DTCC, Power BI Dashboard Design, Basic SQL, Blue Prism Robotics Testing, TLM (Transaction
Lifecycle Management) System
Professional Strengths: Project Management, Automation Enabler, Process Migration, Advanced Data Visualization, Inter- team Coordination

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
SS&C GlobeOp Financial Services India Pvt. Ltd. Senior Associate — Reconciliation & Operations Mumbai, MH | January 2024 – Present
Reconciliation & Automation: Actively drive the automated booking models for highly diversified financial products. • System Reconciliation: Perform rigorous daily reconciliations across Counterparties, Prime Brokers, and Custodians covering Equities, Corporate Actions, Money Markets, Derivatives, and Open Trade Equity.
Exception Management: Investigate unrecognized structural breaks and perform clearing routines on daily reconciliations to minimize ledger disparities.
Reporting & KPI Oversight: Prepare comprehensive month-end reconciliations and critical Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reports; present Key Risk Indicator (KRI) reports to global clients and higher internal management.
Project Management & Migration: Champion User Acceptance Testing (UAT) models and process migration workflows
across a multi-client base.
Business Requirements: Execute Business Requirement Document (BRD) reviews and manage pipeline workflows within Jira
to sustain standard operating procedures.
Robotics Automation: Implement Blue Prism robotics testing matrices designed around complex Over-The-Counter (OTC)
and exchange-traded derivative instruments.
Key Milestone: Recognized and honored with the prestigious client-driven "Star Award" in August 2025 for driving
exceptional operational integrity.
eClerx Services Limited Senior Analyst — Trade Transaction Reporting Operations Mumbai, MH | June 2022 – December 2023
Change Management Framework: Participated in advanced stratification workflows to engineer automated, cycle-on-cycle
verification frameworks for EMIR, CFTC, and SEC frameworks.
• Control Architecture: Evaluated current operational compliance data points to maintain timely, highly accurate reporting
structures.
• Data Analytics & Dashboards: Configured business analytics visuals, operational sprint tracking, and functional dashboards
using SQL and Power BI query architectures.
Regulatory Migration: Formed a core structural part of the regulatory migration task-force executing transitions from CFTC 1.0 to 2.0 and SEC 1.0 to 2.0.
Cyclical Compliance Verification: Processed systematic reconciliations separating internal risk architectures from production
realities; systematically resolved anomalies by raising formal process observations.
Field-Level Diagnostics: Executed continuous field-level multi-data cross-checks for localized CFTC 2.0 and SEC 2.0
compliance blocks.
Root Cause Mitigation: Commanded activities within the Cross-Regime Observation Squad, implementing rigorous root-
cause analyses on complex transaction reporting disruptions while managing cross-functional tasks with RTB and CTB teams. • Key Milestone: Rewarded with the client-driven "Value Award" in June 2023 in recognition of operational value and process
enhancement.
Nomura Services India Pvt. Ltd. Analyst — Reconciliation & Financial Operations Mumbai, MH | January 2020 – April 2022
System Transformation: Drove transactional change engineering during structural migrations onto the Transaction Lifecycle Management (TLM) platform.
Macro Automation: Engineered functional VBA-style macros to eliminate manual iterations across repetitive business activities, saving daily execution time.
Quality Assurance Auditing: Governed automated checking routines across systemic internal TLM Admin team assignments
to verify zero variance errors.
Asset Segregation Protocols: Processed complex unapplied money files and enforced complete segregation of structural client
funds under regulatory capital baselines.
Risk Modeling & Documentation: Designed and updated local documentation outlining Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), maximizing team knowledge on risks.
Account Infrastructure: Managed complete configuration database routines covering both setup and closure parameters for
Nomura's corporate Nostro and Depot banking infrastructure.
Message Queue Remediation: Resolved complex un-cleared item flags, clearing unmatched Swift receipts stuck in active
Message Maintenance Queues.
Key Milestone: Achieved Gold Medal at the regional Sports for Charity Event in 2020 competing in Chess.
